links.outcome: LLM classification accuracy versus human accuracy on same reports, by task
links.effect: Metastasis status: all LLMs non-inferior to humans (gpt-oss:120b 97.6% vs human 98.4%). Treatment response: all LLMs inferior (best 78.3% vs human 86.0%, -7.7 pp).
links.quote: In this study, LLMs were non-inferior to human accuracy for classification of metastasis status but were inferior for response to treatment assessment.

unlisted_practices: Locally hosted LLMs inside the hospital network to preserve privacy
Preregistered non-inferiority design with a prespecified 5 percentage point margin

screen.reason: Retrospective benchmark comparing the accuracy of five locally hosted LLMs against human performance for data extraction from oncology radiology reports, without testing a deployment safeguard or practice.
